name: crew-harness
description: Installer for the Crew GSD + gstack + Superpowers workflow integration.

scripts.test: npm run test:l1 && python tests/run_installer_smoke.py && python tests/run_installed_lib_smoke.py && python tests/run_v061_l0.py
scripts.test:l1: node -e "const n=require('fs').readdirSync('e2e/contract',{recursive:true}).filter(f=>String(f).endsWith('.test.cjs')).length;if(!n)throw new Error('L1 gate found no *.test.cjs under e2e/contract - refusing to report a vacuous pass')" && node --test "e2e/contract/**/*.test.cjs"
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const v=require('fs').readFileSync('VERSION','utf8').trim();if(v.includes('-'))throw new Error('refusing to publish prerelease VERSION '+v)" && node scripts/build-capabilities.cjs --check && node -e "const s=require('child_process').execSync('git status --porcelain',{encoding:'utf8'});if(s.trim())throw new Error('refusing to publish from a dirty tree:\n'+s)"
